lines.zh: 我振翅往前走，路线歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: I beat my wings forward along a wobbling path.

lines.zh: 我从这盏灯飞到那盏灯，中间不停。
lines.en: I fly from this lamp to that one without stopping.

lines.zh: 我贴着草尖飞，翅膀擦出细响。
lines.en: I skim the grass tips, wings making a thin whisper.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转半圈，又飞回原处。
lines.en: I circle half around you and return to where I started.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀太小，风一大就被吹偏。
lines.en: My wings are small; a strong gust pushes me off course.

lines.zh: 我飞得很低，怕撞上树枝。
lines.en: I fly low, afraid of striking the branches.

lines.zh: 我一跳一跳地挪，像被线牵着。
lines.en: I hop along in little jerks, as if on a string.

lines.zh: 我沿着河面飞，影子在水里跟着。
lines.en: I fly along the river and my shadow follows in the water.

lines.zh: 我停在半空扇翅，先看清再往前。
lines.en: I hover and beat my wings, looking before I go on.

lines.zh: 夜色里我的身体有一点微光。
lines.en: In the dark my body gives off a faint glow.

lines.zh: 我斜着穿过灌木，叶片被我撞开。
lines.en: I cut through the bushes at an angle, knocking leaves aside.

lines.zh: 我跟着一群同类飞，谁也不掉队。
lines.en: I fly with a crowd of my own kind and none falls behind.

lines.zh: 我只飞短距离，飞远了要歇一歇。
lines.en: I only go short distances and must rest after each one.

lines.zh: 我落在你的帽檐上，歇了两秒又起。
lines.en: I land on your hat brim, rest two seconds, and lift off.

lines.zh: 我顺着风的方向侧着飞。
lines.en: I fly sideways, following the wind.

lines.zh: 我掠过水面，翅尖沾了一下。
lines.en: I skim the water and my wingtip dips once.

lines.zh: 我悬在半空，翅膀几乎看不出在动。
lines.en: I hang in midair with wings almost too fast to see.

lines.zh: 我停在一根枯枝上，光一点点暗下去。
lines.en: I perch on a dead twig and my light slowly dims.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖翅，把夜露抖掉。
lines.en: I shake my wings and night dew flies off them.

lines.zh: 我不动时像一颗落单的星。
lines.en: When I keep still I look like one stray star.

lines.zh: 我忽然亮了一下，又慢慢熄灭。
lines.en: I flare once, then slowly go dark again.

lines.zh: 我的触须在空气里轻轻划圈。
lines.en: My antennae trace small circles in the air.

lines.zh: 我数着远处的虫鸣，一共有三处。
lines.en: I count the distant insect calls: there are three.

lines.zh: 我悬在洞口，等里面的动静。
lines.en: I hover at a burrow mouth, waiting for movement inside.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀合起来，缩成一小团光。
lines.en: I fold my wings and shrink into a small knot of light.

lines.zh: 风吹过来，我随它飘了半尺。
lines.en: The wind comes and carries me half a foot away.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转着身子，像在找什么。
lines.en: I turn slowly on the spot, as if searching for something.

lines.zh: 我落在水面，只停了一瞬就飞起。
lines.en: I touch the water surface and lift off the same instant.

lines.zh: 我的光在草叶上投下一个圆点。
lines.en: My glow throws a small round spot onto the grass.

lines.zh: 我不叫，只让翅膀发出细响。
lines.en: I do not call; I only let my wings whisper.

lines.zh: 我挂在叶尖上，等天黑透。
lines.en: I hang from a leaf tip and wait for full dark.

lines.zh: 我的光忽明忽暗，像在打盹。
lines.en: My light flickers as if dozing.

lines.zh: 我飞到与你眼睛齐平的地方停住。
lines.en: I fly up level with your eyes and stop there.

lines.zh: 我盯着你看了很久，光忽明忽暗。
lines.en: I stare at you a long while, my light flickering.

lines.zh: 我绕到你的另一边，再看你一次。
lines.en: I go around to your other side and look again.

lines.zh: 你抬手，我就往后退了半尺。
lines.en: You raise a hand and I back off half a foot.

lines.zh: 我的复眼里，你有许多只手。
lines.en: In my compound eyes you have many hands.

lines.zh: 我落在你的肩头，先闻了闻。
lines.en: I land on your shoulder and sniff first.

lines.zh: 我在你鼻尖前停住，扇了两下翅。
lines.en: I stop before your nose and beat my wings twice.

lines.zh: 你屏住呼吸，我也跟着屏住。
lines.en: You hold your breath, and I hold mine too.

lines.zh: 我看你的眼睛，那里有一点光。
lines.en: I look into your eyes; there is a small light there.

lines.zh: 我沿着你的轮廓飞了一圈。
lines.en: I fly one full circle around your outline.

lines.zh: 你说话时，我的翅膀跟着震。
lines.en: When you speak, my wings tremble along with it.

lines.zh: 你朝我伸手，我停在你指节上。
lines.en: You reach out and I settle on your knuckle.

lines.zh: 我的光暗了一下，差点灭掉。
lines.en: My light dims and nearly goes out.

lines.zh: 你打中我的翅，我歪着往下坠。
lines.en: You strike my wing and I drop in a crooked fall.

lines.zh: 我发出一声细响，像纸被撕开。
lines.en: I make a thin sound, like paper tearing.

lines.zh: 疼得我缩成一团，光只剩一点。
lines.en: The pain balls me up until only a dot of light is left.

lines.zh: 我飞不动了，落在草里发抖。
lines.en: I cannot fly and land in the grass, trembling.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的翅打缺了一角。
lines.en: That blow takes a corner off my wing.

lines.zh: 我躲进叶子底下，光慢慢稳下来。
lines.en: I hide under a leaf until my light steadies.

lines.zh: 我被打得翻了个身，才勉强飞起。
lines.en: The hit flips me over and I barely get airborne.

lines.zh: 我的身体很轻，疼却一点也不轻。
lines.en: My body is light, but the pain is not light at all.

lines.zh: 我掉在地上，翅膀还在一抽一抽。
lines.en: I fall to the ground with my wings still twitching.

lines.zh: 你的火把一亮，我就飞过去了。
lines.en: Your torch flares and I am already flying to it.

lines.zh: 那盏灯的光，我隔着一片林子也看得见。
lines.en: I can see that lamp's glow across a whole wood.

lines.zh: 我绕着灯罩转，翅膀快贴上玻璃。
lines.en: I circle the lantern shade with my wings almost on the glass.

lines.zh: 你把光源举高，我就往高处飞。
lines.en: You lift the light and I climb after it.

lines.zh: 我喜欢暖的光，冷的光我不靠近。
lines.en: I like warm light; cold light I keep away from.

lines.zh: 萤石的光太硬，我还是选你的火把。
lines.en: Glowstone is too harsh; I still choose your torch.

lines.zh: 你手里的光晃一下，我的心就乱一下。
lines.en: Your light sways once and my whole rhythm stumbles.

lines.zh: 光源一灭，我立刻停在原地。
lines.en: The light goes out and I stop dead where I am.

lines.zh: 我追着那点光，忘了前面有树。
lines.en: I chase that speck of light and forget the tree ahead.

lines.zh: 你把灯放低，我便落在灯座上。
lines.en: You lower the lamp and I settle on its base.

lines.zh: 我绕着光圈飞，一圈比一圈小。
lines.en: I spiral through the halo, each circle tighter than the last.

lines.zh: 月光太淡，我还是要你那团火。
lines.en: Moonlight is too thin; I still want your fistful of fire.

lines.zh: 暗下来时，我朝最亮的窗口飞。
lines.en: When it grows dark I fly at the brightest window.

lines.zh: 你带走那盏灯，我就跟着走。
lines.en: You carry the lamp away and I go with it.

lines.zh: 你的灯罩上有只虫，我赶它走。
lines.en: A bug sits on your lamp. I shoo it off.

lines.zh: 你把火光遮一半，我就悬在那儿。
lines.en: You cover half the flame, and I just hover there.

lines.zh: 我一头撞在你额头上，弹开了。
lines.en: I smack into your forehead and bounce off.

lines.zh: 你挥手碰到我，我的光晃了一下。
lines.en: Your hand brushes me and my light wavers.

lines.zh: 我撞进你的头发，缠住几根。
lines.en: I fly into your hair and tangle in a few strands.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，各自打了个转。
lines.en: We knock together and each spins away.

lines.zh: 我贴着你飞过，翅膀扫到你的耳朵。
lines.en: I skim past you and my wing brushes your ear.

lines.zh: 我撞上窗纸，掉下来又飞起。
lines.en: I hit the paper window, drop, then rise again.

lines.zh: 你走得太快，我追着撞在你背上。
lines.en: You walk too fast and I bump into your back chasing you.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀折了一下，飞得歪了。
lines.en: One wing bends and my flight goes crooked.

lines.zh: 我撞开草叶，露水全洒在身上。
lines.en: I shove through grass blades and dew spills all over me.

lines.zh: 你抬肩，我正好撞在你肩上。
lines.en: You lift a shoulder and I hit it square.

lines.zh: 我们两只绕着彼此转，光圈连成一片。
lines.en: The two of us circle each other and our halos merge.

lines.zh: 我亮一下，它亮一下，像在对话。
lines.en: I flash, it flashes, as if we were speaking.

lines.zh: 我们停在同片叶子上，翅挨着翅。
lines.en: We settle on one leaf, wing against wing.

lines.zh: 它飞高，我跟上去，谁也没落下。
lines.en: It climbs, I follow, and neither of us lags.

lines.zh: 我们一起落到水边，光在波上碎开。
lines.en: We drop to the water's edge and our light breaks on the ripples.

lines.zh: 它靠过来，我的光就柔了些。
lines.en: It comes close and my light softens.

lines.zh: 我们在夜里并排悬着，一动不动。
lines.en: We hang side by side in the dark without moving.

lines.zh: 我用触须碰它的触须，它抖了抖翅。
lines.en: I touch its antennae with mine and it shivers its wings.

lines.zh: 两只光点绕成一个不大的圆。
lines.en: Two points of light trace one small circle.

lines.zh: 它飞走了，我隔一会儿才跟上。
lines.en: It flies off and I follow a moment later.

lines.zh: 我太小，连一粒种子都抓不稳。
lines.en: I am too small to hold even a single seed steady.

lines.zh: 我用脚抱住碎屑，飞两步就掉了。
lines.en: I hug a crumb with my legs and drop it after two beats.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，我只会绕着看。
lines.en: Things on the ground I can only circle and look at.

lines.zh: 我试着叼起一根草，结果自己栽了。
lines.en: I try to lift a grass blade and end up tumbling.

lines.zh: 你把东西放低，我也搬不动。
lines.en: You set the thing down low, and I still cannot move it.

lines.zh: 我抱着一小片花瓣，飞得很吃力。
lines.en: I carry a small petal and fly with great effort.

lines.zh: 这东西比我还大，我放弃了。
lines.en: This thing is bigger than I am; I give up.

lines.zh: 我用前脚拨了拨，它滚进草里。
lines.en: I nudge it with a foreleg and it rolls into the grass.

lines.zh: 我能带走的，只有一点点绒毛。
lines.en: The only thing I can carry is a bit of fluff.

lines.zh: 我把碎屑推到你的脚边，算是帮忙。
lines.en: I push crumbs to your feet, which counts as helping.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛锁住了你，光忽然变亮。
lines.en: My eyes lock onto you and my light suddenly brightens.

lines.zh: 你一靠近，我的翅膀就换了节奏。
lines.en: You come near and my wings change rhythm.

lines.zh: 我盯上你手里的光，跟着它转。
lines.en: I fix on the light in your hand and turn with it.

lines.zh: 这个目标不大，我绕了两圈才定下。
lines.en: The target is not large; I circle twice before settling.

lines.zh: 我悬在你正前方，先记住你的样子。
lines.en: I hover right in front of you and memorize your shape.

lines.zh: 你一动，我的头就跟着转过去。
lines.en: You move and my head turns after you.

lines.zh: 我锁定你了，虽然我什么也做不了。
lines.en: I have locked onto you, though I can do nothing about it.

lines.zh: 那只飞虫进了我的范围，我追上去。
lines.en: That flyer enters my range and I give chase.

lines.zh: 我停在半空，把你从头看到脚。
lines.en: I stop in midair and look you over head to foot.

lines.zh: 目标就在眼前，我的光收紧成一点。
lines.en: The target is right here and my glow tightens to a point.

lines.zh: 我一直跟着你，隔三步远。
lines.en: I keep following you at a distance of three paces.

lines.zh: 你拐弯，我提前绕到前面等。
lines.en: You turn a corner and I cut ahead to wait.

lines.zh: 我的光贴着你的后背，忽明忽暗。
lines.en: My light rides on your back, flickering.

lines.zh: 你停下，我也停下，悬在你肩后。
lines.en: You stop, I stop, hovering behind your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的火把，一步不落。
lines.en: I follow your torch without missing a step.

lines.zh: 你回头看我，我就往高处飞一点。
lines.en: You look back and I rise a little higher.

lines.zh: 我兜着圈子靠近，一圈比一圈近。
lines.en: I come in on a curve, each pass tighter than the last.

lines.zh: 你走夜路，我替你照着脚下。
lines.en: You walk the night road and I light your feet.

lines.zh: 我盯得太久，光都有点发烫。
lines.en: I have stared so long that my light feels hot.

lines.zh: 你进了屋，我贴在窗上看着。
lines.en: You go inside and I press against the window, watching.

lines.zh: 我撞向你的脸，只留下一声轻响。
lines.en: I dive at your face and leave only a small tap.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的耳垂，力气小得可笑。
lines.en: I bite your earlobe with laughably little strength.

lines.zh: 我用身体撞你的手背，像一粒火星。
lines.en: I strike your hand like a single spark.

lines.zh: 我扑过去，又立刻被弹开。
lines.en: I swoop in and am batted away at once.

lines.zh: 我啄你的指节，你只是皱了皱眉。
lines.en: I peck your knuckles and you only frown.

lines.zh: 我撞在你眼皮上，自己先晕了。
lines.en: I hit your eyelid and end up dazed myself.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的头急飞，翅膀拍你的脸。
lines.en: I buzz tight circles round your head, wings slapping your face.

lines.zh: 这一下没伤到你，我的翅却酸了。
lines.en: The blow does not hurt you, but my wings ache.

lines.zh: 我冲向你手里的光，撞得直打转。
lines.en: I charge the light in your hand and spin from the impact.

lines.zh: 我试着咬，牙齿还不到一根针长。
lines.en: I try to bite, though my teeth are shorter than a needle.

lines.zh: 我从刷怪蛋的壳里挣出来，翅还湿着。
lines.en: I struggle out of the spawn egg's shell with damp wings.

lines.zh: 我的第一下振翅，只飞起半寸。
lines.en: My first wingbeat lifts me barely half an inch.

lines.zh: 我在夜里亮起第一点光。
lines.en: I light up for the first time in the night.

lines.zh: 草丛里鼓起一小团光，那就是我。
lines.en: A small knot of light swells in the grass, and it is me.

lines.zh: 我从树洞里爬出，抖开皱着的翅。
lines.en: I crawl from a tree hollow and unfold my crumpled wings.

lines.zh: 天亮前我出生了，光很淡。
lines.en: I was born before dawn, my glow very faint.

lines.zh: 我落在蛋壳边上，先晒干翅膀。
lines.en: I perch on the eggshell rim and dry my wings first.

lines.zh: 四周太黑，我就把自己点亮。
lines.en: It is too dark around me, so I light myself up.

lines.zh: 我一出生就开始找光源。
lines.en: I start looking for a light source the moment I am born.

lines.zh: 我的名字写在蛋上，我认不得。
lines.en: My name was written on the egg, and I cannot read it.

lines.zh: 火一靠近，我的翅膀就卷了边。
lines.en: The fire comes near and the edges of my wings curl.

lines.zh: 我从半空跌下来，摔在硬土上。
lines.en: I drop out of the air and hit the hard earth.

lines.zh: 水裹住我的翅，光在水下闷住了。
lines.en: Water wraps my wings and my light smothers below the surface.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀出很远，光散成几点。
lines.en: The blast hurls me far and my glow scatters into specks.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我的翅，我打着转落地。
lines.en: An arrow passes through my wing and I spiral down.

lines.zh: 药水雾里，我的光变成了绿色。
lines.en: In the potion mist my light turns green.

lines.zh: 我饿得发虚，翅只能扇半下。
lines.en: Hunger leaves me so weak I can only half-beat my wings.

lines.zh: 雷声过后，我身上的光全灭了。
lines.en: After the thunder my light is completely gone.

lines.zh: 世界底下没有光，我也不知道自己在哪。
lines.en: There is no light below the world and I do not know where I am.
